title: Warrior Frostbreaker Build
lede: A Greatsword build from level 1 to endgame, based on RaidDex's Frostbreaker and its Greatsword leveling route. Shields from Pommel Strike and Brace keep you upright, Freeze sets up big vertical hits, and you swap to the Longsword to heal.

notice.title: Not verified in-game yet.
notice.text: Early Access opened on November 3, 2026. I cross-checked every Warrior guide I could find and tagged each claim by how well it's supported. Both trait trees are built from Wikily's node lists (Greatsword 55, Longsword 60). The layouts are approximate until I have a screenshot of your Warrior trait screens.

stages.name: Leveling
stages.goal: Level on the Greatsword. Arc, Chain and Sweeping Slash clear packs, and Demolishing Strike into Fatal Cleave handles tough enemies.
weapons: Longsword on {Q} when you need to heal [one]
skills: Arc, Chain, Vertical, Rising and Final Cleave are granted free [me]
Pommel Strike gives a long shield that scales with Max HP [ok]
Demolishing Strike counters after a Blade Guard block. With Expert it costs no SP [one]
traits: Greatsword only until about 22 points, then add the Longsword for healing [one]
Follow the Greatsword trait order below [me]
gear: RaidDex's spreads (STR/CON/END): Lv 15 at 24/16/2, Lv 30 at 42/32/10 plus 3 Talent, Lv 40 at 54/45/15 [one]
check: Put Greatsword and Longsword on Q swap
Unlock Pommel Strike and Demolishing Strike
Pick up every Raeven's Coilstone you pass
Reach Fatal Cleave in the trait order

stages.name: Gearing
stages.goal: Add the Freeze and shield lines, and start the Longsword healing kit.
skills: Cross Slash → Rain Cleave → Downpour Slash hit harder while you're shielded [one]
Frosted Gleam: Sweeping Slash builds Freeze and briefly enables Final Cleave [one]
traits: Longsword: Whirlwind Slash → Lifeflame → Heavy Kick first [me]
gear: Raise Talent toward 23 for the endgame weapons [ok]

stages.name: Endgame
stages.goal: Shield up, freeze the target, then cash in with Final Cleave and Rampage.
skills: Rampage: Unbridled Might on Final Cleave adds a free charged Final Cleave [ok]
Bloodforge and Crimson Surge on the Longsword for healing [one]
traits: 56 Greatsword and 36 Longsword uses all 92 Early Access points [me]
check: Land Rampage in a boss fight

trees.intro: All 55 Greatsword nodes from Wikily. The layout is approximate: granted skills are grouped on the left, as in-game [me]. Nodes marked ✓ are granted free: Proficiency plus every skill that doesn't branch from it. They aren't counted in your points or in the path totals [ok].

presets.name: Frostbreaker (RaidDex)
presets.note: RaidDex names the skills: Pommel Strike, Cross Slash, Rain Cleave, Downpour Slash, Final Cleave, Rampage, Demolishing Strike, Fatal Cleave, Frosted Gleam and Frostfang. Granted skills are left out. The order follows the leveling route (defense first) and is mine [me].

trees.intro: All 60 Longsword nodes from Wikily. The layout is approximate [me]. Nodes marked ✓ are granted free and aren't counted in your points [ok].

presets.name: Blood healing swap (36 points)
presets.note: The guides swap to the Longsword to heal. This path takes the blood line (Lifeflame, Bloodstorm, Frenzy, Hemorrhage, Bloodforge, Crimson Surge) from RaidDex's Crimson Blade. The order is mine [me].

treeHelp: Click a node to read it. Double-click it, or press Space, to unlock or refund it. Nodes marked ✓ are granted free: default skills that cost no trait points. Fill with my points buys the build path in order until your points run out. Each weapon's tree is saved in this browser.

rotation.title: Frostbreaker rotation
rotation.intro: RaidDex's Frostbreaker chain [one]. Swap weapons with {Q}.

steps.d: A long shield that scales with Max HP. Brace (free) makes you stagger-immune while it holds.
Cross Slash combos from Arc Slash and hits harder while you're shielded.
Breaks guard and knocks down. Downpour gives Rain Cleave one more use.
With Unbridled Might up, Rampage adds a free charged Final Cleave.

steps.t: Loop Arc, Chain and Sweeping Slash
steps.d: Sweeping Slash builds Freeze with Frosted Gleam, which re-opens Final Cleave.

steps.t: Block, then Demolishing Strike → Fatal Cleave
steps.d: Use Blade Guard while shielded, counter with Demolishing Strike, then Fatal Cleave to strip shields.

rotation.after: When SP runs low or you're missing health, swap to the Longsword with {Q} for Lifeflame and Bloodstorm healing.

split.intro: Trait points come from Raeven's Coilstones near powerful bosses [ok]. RaidDex's Frostbreaker goes 56 / 44 and Crimson Blade goes 43 / 57.

disputes: A creator tier list gives the Longsword C for PvE. AOEAH rates it 7/10 for PvE and 10/10 for PvP. Kybuza, Nerd Bird and Theory Forge favor the Greatsword for PvE.
Greatsword main, Longsword as the healing swap.
RaidDex: STR, then CON (plenty), then Talent. Kybuza: STR, then AGI, adding CON and END only as needed.
Follow RaidDex. Stats respec free, so try Kybuza's spread if you want more crit.
Destructoid rates the Warrior S. ArcheAge Builds places it at A for PvP.
Both are strong. Pick it if you like it.
None of the guides say which skills are free. ArcheAge World's planner says the default "white" skills cost nothing.
Skills that don't branch from Proficiency are free here, matching the Berserker and Ranger screens [me].
